report.explanation: Alert reports degraded checkout health, but current telemetry shows only healthy 200/ok responses from gateway, payment, and inventory. Order logs show 9 WARN retained_heap_after_gc events, but no memory-retention series or baseline is supplied, so a leak cannot be established. No evidence supports any bounded root cause; hand off for further telemetry.
missing_evidence: Order service heap usage and GC metrics over time to assess retained_heap_after_gc trend
Baseline or prior-period retained_heap_after_gc counts for order service
Latency and error-rate metrics for checkout path to confirm degradation
Deployment records for the incident window
